verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly document destroy mode via `tofu plan -destroy` (and implicitly `tofu apply -destroy`/`tofu destroy`), stating it creates a plan to destroy all remote objects leaving an empty state, and `tofu test` shows destroy being used automatically to tear down created infrastructure. Missing for 10: no dedicated `tofu destroy` command page cited and no independent hands-on report specifically validating a full environment teardown.
